procedure: Run 18 independent Isaac episodes: parent plus actor for each of three arms and courses. The early arm uses 1.2 until frame 9 and 0.8 from frame 10, regardless of outcome or learned classifier. Audit command reconstruction, parent/actor provenance and physical trajectories. Compare to same-source controls, not v301 outcomes.
mechanism_gate: Complete all 3 courses; early switch changes root XY before first contact by >=0.02 m relative to full 1.2 on at least 2 courses; rescues >=1 of 2 preselected risk cases to clean-foot/no-out; retains high quality on the single gain case; zero new baseline-clean to nonfoot or out-of-play.
